faq.q: What counts as a standard AI edit?
faq.a: A standard AI edit represents a bounded, authorized engineering task. Complex operations or stronger reasoning can consume multiple standard edits. Applicable usage must be shown before execution; internal model calls are not separate customer edits.

faq.q: Do monthly edits change with quarterly or yearly billing?
faq.a: No. Your edit allowance renews monthly regardless of your billing period. Paying quarterly or yearly does not grant all usage upfront. Unused included edits do not roll over.

faq.q: Which billing periods can I choose?
faq.a: Online checkout is available for monthly subscriptions. Quarterly and yearly amounts are shown for comparison only. Enterprise arrangements are negotiated individually.

faq.q: Does one subscription cover every interface?
faq.a: One Vector OS account follows you across the desktop application, web workspace and available native engineering integrations included in your plan. You do not purchase a separate subscription for each included interface. Availability still depends on supported releases and applications.

faq.q: Does the professional group include team seats?
faq.a: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Pro Advanced, Pro Max and Ultra are individual subscriptions for one user. Enterprise can include negotiated seats, organization management and shared workflows through a separate agreement.

faq.q: Do I need separate engineering-software licenses?
faq.a: Yes. Vector OS does not include third-party Rhino, Revit or other engineering-software licenses. You need the required compatible software and licenses; only explicitly supported applications, versions and operations are available.

faq.q: Can I subscribe or upgrade on this page?
faq.a: Yes. Choose a monthly plan to subscribe securely through Stripe without a Vector OS sign-in. Stripe collects your checkout email and manages the recurring payment. Account sign-in and automatic access activation are coming later; use your checkout email when contacting support. Capabilities and edit allowances still depend on supported releases.

Contact the existing project sales email to discuss your organization. Usage, seats, integrations, security, deployment and support are scoped individually. Potential capabilities require a written commercial and technical agreement; they are not included by default.
